rules.title: Geometric separation
rules.text: Maintain the selected separation from the beam, slab and zone boundary.

rules.title: Occupied-zone headroom
rules.text: Keep the service underside above the selected minimum. This condition applies to the occupied zone; plant-only bays require separate review.

rules.title: Maintenance access
rules.text: Keep the declared maintenance volume free of the service and its separation allowance while this requirement is active.

scope: Finite authored candidate grammar; geometric checks against authored assumptions. No certified design, pressure-loss, fire, structural or compliance analysis.
